title: Guidance – Agentic Field Technician Assistant
tools: AI Agents (Google Gemini) · Application Development (Python, React)
blurb: 1st of 20 teams at BeaverHacks 2026: a Gemini agent that answers a technician's photo-and-voice questions and draws the next step on the image.
long: I built this app end to end over 24 hours with my team at BeaverHacks 2026, we won 1st place out of 20 teams in the beginner track.

The technician takes photos using a laptop webcam or connected phone, and asks a question via voice or text input. The multi-step Gemini pipeline processes the images, provides an answer in the form of verbal instructions, creates an annotated drawing on the image, illustrating the next step, and reads the response aloud.
The machine manuals are accessed locally (RAG) via function calling, keyed to the specific machine using a QR code, with task state maintained so the assistant remembers what’s been tried.
highlights: Image + audio input, spoken output, annotated diagrams
